Rep. Doggett’s outrage misses the point—border security IS healthcare. Chaos from Biden’s open borders overwhelmed hospitals, diverted resources, and let cartels flood communities with fentanyl. 

Trump’s policies prioritize Americans first by stopping the invasion, securing ports, and deporting criminal illegals who drain public funds. The real cruelty? Letting unvetted migrants jump the line ahead of citizens. 

Fix the border, save lives.

The tariff exemption process under the previous administration was a swamp of political favoritism - studies show GOP donors got 3.94% higher approval odds while Democrat contributors faced penalties. But here's the reality: chaotic execution undermines America's trade goals.

The current 125% China tariff with narrowed exemptions aims to correct past graft, though recent semiconductor flip-flops prove consistency remains elusive. Trade policy shouldn't be a loyalty rewards program - it needs surgical precision against China's IP theft, not bureaucratic score-settling.

The mission was right; the execution got hijacked by DC's pay-to-play culture. Time to end the whiplash and deliver stable, transparent trade rules that put American workers first - not political operatives.
